_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-09. CardID = 17600 + idx; 303 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 3). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [303, 17629]. His deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's and the Marvel/Tales to Amaze decks': only deck.identity (data/tts/sinbad.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Restriction band (SINBAD, THE PORTER or ANY) and copies (xN printed on each card) read from the images; type, value, boost and text of the 16 titles agree with unmatched-memory except the ability wording (the card says 'your fighters', unmatched-memory 'fighters'). The seven VOYAGE cards carry the tag `voyage` (the HeroDef counter `voyage` counts it in the discard pile); six of them print no BOOST value (boost 0, so they cannot be spent as a boost; unmatched-memory has null), Voyage Home prints BOOST 1.

Hero card (read from the image): SINBAD, MELEE, START HEALTH 15, MOVE 2; special ability 'When you maneuver, you may move your fighters +1 space for each VOYAGE card in your discard pile.' Sidekick THE PORTER, MELEE, START HEALTH 6 (the card prints the move once, 2, for both). One Porter. The inner bag also holds a model named 'Voyages' (10bbcb) that no rule uses (docs/heroes/sinbad.md).
